say.line: The oil is built like your own sebum, so hardened blackheads dissolve into it.

say.line: It's been through a human trial for blackhead cleansing.

howto.name: Reapplying

howto.name: Where in the routine

say.line: It's an organic filter sunscreen, so there's no white cast and it goes on light.
